## Summary

Fixes the post-merge ADR 0122 validation regression without changing spatial-audio runtime or serialization contracts. The legacy three-argument Inspector helper exists only to support test-only UI callers, so it is compiled only under `cfg(test)` while production continues to use the scroll-capable helper.

## Validation

Fresh Windows affected validation is required on the final head. Visual validation will verify both the Spatial Audio overview/gizmos and the scrolled Spatial Audio Details inspector on the same final head.
